title: Incident Loop Trace
description: Schema for incident-loop-agent GCL trace files written to audit-results/incident-trace-<ticket_id>-<ISO>.json

started_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the loop started

finished_at.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the loop finished

policy_decision.description: Policy verdict from T05 Step 5a scoreDecision

iterations.description: One entry per GCL loop iteration

ve_calls.description: All ve CLI invocations in this iteration

request_id.description: RequestId from ve CLI output (required, must be non-empty)

redaction_pass.description: Must be true — credentials must be masked in all trace output
